name: Thaumaturgy: Spirit Thaumaturgy — 3 Advanced — Evil Eye

system.description: You can summon a wraith to harass a victim for a duration determined by the number of Mental Traits expended into the challenge. You must defeat the victim in a Mental Challenge; if successful, the victim must bid two extra Traits in any challenges for 10 minutes. You may extend the duration of harassment at the cost of one Mental Trait per five minutes.
